entries.change_state: state (project pack maps this to change_state)
entries.name: title

descr.API: An interface a service exposes and others consume
descr.Application: A deployable business system made of services
descr.Capability: What the enterprise can do, independent of the systems that deliver it
descr.Change: A unit of work that alters a system: a ticket, pull request or change record
descr.ComplianceControl: A control that belongs to a named control set, such as PCI-DSS
descr.Control: A measure that meets a policy or regulation
descr.DataAsset: Data held by the enterprise: a database, dataset or topic. Metadata only, never row data (HLD 5.2)
descr.Decision: A recorded choice and its reason, such as an ADR
descr.Incident: An unplanned event that disrupted a service
descr.PaymentScheme: A card or payment network rulebook the organization must follow (HLD 6 Table 10 example)
descr.Person: A person, recorded by role only (HLD 6 Table 9). No names or contact details.
descr.Policy: A rule that governs behaviour, such as change control for payment systems
descr.Release: A versioned set of changes put into an environment
descr.Requirement: A stated need a change must satisfy
descr.Service: A running unit of software with one owning team
descr.Team: A group that owns things and is accountable for them
descr.Test: A check that shows a change or service behaves as required
